response.sql:
WITH college_counts AS (
  SELECT college_id, COUNT(*) as count
  FROM player_college
  GROUP BY college_id
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(count) as avg_all_colleges,
    SUM(count) as total_count
  FROM college_counts
),
above_avg_colleges AS (
  SELECT 
    cc.college_id, 
    cc.count, 
    os.avg_all_colleges, 
    os.total_count
  FROM college_counts cc
  CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
  WHERE cc.count > os.avg_all_colleges
)
SELECT 
  AVG(count) as metric_1,
  AVG(CAST(count AS FLOAT) / total_count) as metric_2,
  AVG(count - avg_all_colleges) as metric_3
FROM above_avg_colleges

assumptions.assumption: Metric (2) 'the average of each such college's count divided by the total of the counts summed over all colleges' is interpreted as AVG(count / total_count)—calculating the ratio for each college individually, then averaging those ratios—rather than AVG(count) / total_count.

alternatives.interpretation: Metric (2) could mean (AVG(count) / total_count): the average count of above-average colleges divided by the total count across all colleges.
